symptom: `mxcli refs <Module.Read_X>` says "no references found" for a microflow that is a published OData resource's `ReadMode: microflow`, and likewise for the service's `Authentication: (microflow X)`; `impact` agrees and QUAL004 says "Remove if unused" — 35 of one backend's 43 QUAL004 findings were the read microflows and the authentication microflow of six published services (ako/mxcli#1639)
cause: `buildODataServices` wrote only service-level columns and emitted no edge for any microflow the service names: entity-set read/change modes (`CallMicroflow:<qn>` from the reader), published OData actions (`svc.Microflows`), `AuthMicroflow`. Same shape on three siblings the reader already populates: a published REST service's `AuthenticationMicroflow`, a business event service operation's `Microflow` (stored in business_events_data and dropped), a consumed OData service's configuration / headers / error-handling microflows
file: `mdl/catalog/builder_service_refs.go` (new: `serviceMicroflowRef`, `addServiceMicroflowRefs`, `publishedODataMicroflows`, `extractServiceMicroflowRefs`), collection in `builder_modules.go` (`buildODataServices`, `buildODataClients`, `buildBusinessEventServices`) and `builder_rest.go`, emission in `builder_references.go`, `RefObject*Service` source types, `CatalogSchemaVersion` 28->29; tests `mdl/catalog/builder_service_refs_test.go`
insight: Fifth instance of the class after widget actions, scheduled events, settings, published REST operations and entity events — **audit the whole document family when one pointer is missing**: the reported two (ReadMode, Authentication) sat beside the change modes, the OData actions and three sibling services with the identical gap, found by grepping modelsdk/gen for `*Microflow*QualifiedName()` and checking each against the builders. **Reuse a kind whose consumers already treat it as an entry point** rather than minting one: `publish` (a published service runs it), `event` (an event handler — entity or business event; detail stays in CATALOG.BUSINESS_EVENTS), `call` (the consumed service calls its configuration microflow, as a workflow calls its handlers). A new kind would have needed `callerRefKinds`, `graphRefKinds`, the skill's ref_kind row and the docs; reusing one needed none. The source is the service with its catalog id in SourceId, which joins to the service's own table and to `objects` (the RefObject values equal the objects ObjectType values). Bumped CatalogSchemaVersion: no column changed, but a cached catalog would keep the old edge set until the .mpr changed. Controls: stubbing the collection hooks empties every edge test and GRAPH_DEAD_ASSETS lists Read_Rows again. Real 11.13 app, same model, baseline vs fixed binary: refs for the read, authentication and action microflows, the REST authentication microflow and a business event handler go from "no references" to one row each; QUAL004 drops them, an unreferenced microflow is still reported. Studio Pro-authored ako/TestApp: its OData actions (GetOrder, GetCustomerOrders, SaveOrder) gain publish edges; no Studio Pro document with a read microflow or authentication microflow was available, so those two read paths are verified on mxcli-written documents (keys match generated/metamodel).
